title: Settings
description: Applies to this local Nodestro installation.

language.title: Language
language.label: Interface language
language.automaticHint: Follows your browser's language, currently {{language}}. Unsupported languages show English.
language.hint: Takes effect at once and is remembered, even after a restart.
language.contentNote: The language only changes the interface. Your agents, prompts, workflows and results stay in their original language. New drafts by the AI assistants are written in this language unless you ask for another one.

models.title: Models and budget
models.assistantHint: Designs agents from your description, writes tools and proposes memory.
models.budgetHint: A run stops as soon as the estimated costs exceed the budget. Empty = no limit.
models.architectBudget: Cost limit of the Workflow Architect (USD per draft)
models.architectBudgetHint: The architect stops when a draft costs more. Empty = no limit.
models.architectRepairsHint: How often the architect may ask the AI to fix a configuration or tool draft (0 to 5). Corrections without AI are always made.
models.defaultHint: New agents start with this provider and model.

sandbox.title: Sandbox for your own tools
sandbox.label: Sandbox
sandbox.text: Your own and AI-created tools never run in the Nodestro process. The Python process is available at once; Docker isolates more strongly (no network, limited memory).
sandbox.dockerUnreachable: Docker cannot be reached. Tool tests and calls fail until Docker is running.

about.title: About Nodestro
about.data: All data is stored locally in an SQLite database (default: ~/.nodestro, changeable with NODESTRO_DATA_DIR).

ocr.title: Text recognition (OCR)
ocr.text: Recognises text in scanned PDFs locally with Tesseract. No data is sent anywhere. Uncertain words are marked.
ocr.label: Use OCR for scans

providers.title: AI providers
providers.intro: Nodestro works with several providers at the same time. Each agent uses the provider of its model; nothing switches to another provider on its own.
providers.fromEnvironment: The key comes from the environment variable {{variable}}; a key stored here is not used then.
providers.keyStored: A key is stored. It is never shown and is sent only to this provider.
providers.keyMissing: No key yet. Enter it here or set {{variables}}.
providers.baseUrlDefault: Usually {{url}} for a local server. The provider counts as set up once a base URL is saved.
providers.baseUrlHint: The address of the OpenAI-compatible API, for example https://example.com/v1.
providers.capabilitiesHint: Nodestro assumes nothing about your own servers: options a model cannot do, or that are unknown, are reported as errors instead of being left out.
